cond_0001.intro:
The [Company name masked] in the Department of Neuroscience and the Center of Brain Immunology and Glia (BIG) is seeking to hire a motivated and detail-oriented Lab Specialist to perform and assist with animal colony management, data analysis, and experiments. The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be responsible for managing the lab's animal colony, genotyping, contributing to data analysis, performing molecular studies, and helping to train Graduate Students.
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by performing complex lab and research related tasks. They act as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations. They have the authority to adapt methods and procedures to meet the needs of research. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise necessary to serve as resources on non-routine problems. Provide basic assistance to researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software. Evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses. Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports. Perform library and literature research. Assist in instructing lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety. The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be responsible for managing the lab's animal colony, genotyping, contributing to data analysis, performing molecular studies, and helping to train Graduate Students.
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by performing complex lab and research related tasks. They act as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations. They have the authority to adapt methods and procedures to meet the needs of research. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise necessary to serve as resources on non-routine problems. Lab Specialist employees perform daily activities without supervision; their longer-term assignments require greater oversight. Lab Specialist employees often train others on work processes and policies.
cond_0092.responsibilities: Specialize in lab and/or other research methods and equipment functions specific to Principal Investigators and/or labs. Demonstrate expertise in troubleshooting problems and recommending solutions. Perform a variety of tests requiring high degree of proficiency. Assist in evaluation of research methods, procedures, and techniques based on established objectives. May perform small animal surgery. Provide basic assistance to researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software. Evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses. Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports. Perform library and literature research. Assist in instructing lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety. Explain work instructions and may adapt general methods and procedures in order to meet the needs of the research. Assist in training other staff members on procedures. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0092.requirements:

Bachelor's degree required.
Minimum 6 years of demonstrated lab-related expertise, or 3 years of proven hands-on laboratory experience with a completed degree; student lab experience may count toward this total.

Strong problem-solving abilities with a track record of independent troubleshooting.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced knowledge of new and emerging laboratory techniques, with a demonstrated ability to apply them in a research setting.
Proven ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a demanding research environment.

The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be regularly involved in managing the lab's animal colony, genotyping, contributing to data analysis, performing molecular studies, and helping to train Graduate Students.
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by performing complex lab and research related tasks. They act as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations. They have the authority to adapt methods and procedures to meet the needs of research. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise necessary to serve as resources on non-routine problems. Lab Specialist employees perform daily activities without supervision; their longer-term assignments require greater oversight. Lab Specialist employees regularly train others on work processes and policies.
cond_0105.responsibilities: Specialize in lab and/or other research methods and equipment functions specific to Principal Investigators and/or labs. Actively troubleshoot problems and communicate recommended solutions. Perform a variety of tests requiring high degree of proficiency. Assist in evaluation of research methods, procedures, and techniques based on established objectives. May perform small animal surgery. Provide basic assistance to researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software, and explain findings clearly when needed. Evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses. Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports. Perform library and literature research. Assist in instructing lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety, and handle questions from participants as they arise. Explain work instructions and may adapt general methods and procedures in order to meet the needs of the research. Actively assist in training other staff members on procedures, staying in regular contact to support their progress. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0105.requirements: Bachelor's degree. 3 Years of experience. 6 Years of lab-related experience accepted in lieu of degree. Lab experience may include student experience. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills. Strong problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
cond_0105.values: We value acting with integrity and keeping the interests of others in view. We aim to create positive outcomes through work that is respectful, fair, and responsible.
cond_0105.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.

cond_0294.intro: We are looking for a Lab Specialist to join our team in the Department of Neuroscience and the Center of Brain Immunology and Glia (BIG). The lab investigates the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury. The role involves regular hands-on work with the animal colony, data analysis, and experiments, and includes daily interaction with graduate students and other lab members.
cond_0294.responsibilities:
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by performing complex lab and research related tasks. They act as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations. They have the authority to adapt methods and procedures to meet the needs of research. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise necessary to serve as resources on non-routine problems. Lab Specialist employees perform daily activities without supervision; their longer-term assignments require greater oversight. Lab Specialist employees regularly train others on work processes and policies.
The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To
Specialize in lab and/or other research methods and equipment functions specific to Principal Investigators and/or labs. Demonstrate expertise in troubleshooting problems and recommending solutions, and actively communicate findings to the team. Perform a variety of tests requiring high degree of proficiency. Assist in evaluation of research methods, procedures, and techniques based on established objectives. May perform small animal surgery. Provide basic assistance to researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software. Evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses, and walk colleagues through results as needed. Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports. Perform library and literature research. Assist in instructing lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety. Explain work instructions and may adapt general methods and procedures in order to meet the needs of the research. Actively assist in training other staff members on procedures, initiating discussions to clarify steps and resolve questions. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.

Bachelor's degree, or 6 years of lab-related experience in lieu of degree (lab experience may include student experience)
3 Years of experience
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Preferred Requirements
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including comfort explaining methods and results to colleagues
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills

The lab is investigating the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury.
The incumbent will be responsible for managing the lab's animal colony, genotyping, contributing to data analysis, performing molecular studies, and helping to train Graduate Students.
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by performing complex lab and research related tasks. They act as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations. They have the authority to adapt methods and procedures to meet the needs of research. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise necessary to serve as resources on non-routine problems. Lab Specialist employees perform daily activities without supervision; their longer-term assignments require greater oversight. Lab Specialist employees often train others on work processes and policies.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of neuroinflammation research and the methods that underpin it.
cond_0319.responsibilities: Specialize in lab and/or other research methods and equipment functions specific to Principal Investigators and/or labs. Demonstrate expertise in troubleshooting problems and recommending solutions. Perform a variety of tests requiring high degree of proficiency. Assist in evaluation of research methods, procedures, and techniques based on established objectives. May perform small animal surgery. Provide basic assistance to researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software. Evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses. Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports. Perform library and literature research. Assist in instructing lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety. Explain work instructions and may adapt general methods and procedures in order to meet the needs of the research. Assist in training other staff members on procedures. In addition to the above job responsibilities, other duties may be assigned.
cond_0319.requirements: Bachelor's degree. 3 Years of experience. 6 Years of lab-related experience accepted in lieu of degree. Lab experience may include student experience. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills. Strong problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
cond_0319.values: We value high performance and work that reflects care, discipline, and strong judgment. We believe results matter, and so does the standard behind them.
cond_0319.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.

The lab investigates the role of neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism, and traumatic brain injury. In this role, you will work alongside researchers and graduate students to support animal colony management, data analysis, and experiments.
Lab Specialist employees provide technical lab support by working on complex lab and research-related tasks. They serve as specialists on research methods and equipment functions specific to investigations, and coordinate with the team to adapt methods and procedures to meet research needs. They are distinguished from Lab Technicians by the types and duration of assignments, as well as the skills and expertise needed to help address non-routine problems. Lab Specialist employees carry out daily activities with a degree of independence, while longer-term assignments involve closer coordination with supervisors. Lab Specialist employees often help train others on work processes and policies.
cond_0513.responsibilities:
Work with Principal Investigators and lab members to apply specialized lab and research methods and equipment functions.
Help troubleshoot problems and share recommended solutions with the team.
Perform a variety of tests requiring a high degree of proficiency.
Assist in evaluating research methods, procedures, and techniques based on established objectives.
May perform small animal surgery.
Support researchers in manipulating, computing, and analyzing data using specialized statistical computer software.
Help evaluate experiment results using statistical and multivariate analyses.
Research, compile, and maintain complex statistical, numerical, and computerized reports in coordination with the team.
Assist with library and literature research.
Help instruct lab academic sections in lab methods, procedures, and safety.
Clarify work instructions and help adapt general methods and procedures to meet research needs.
Assist in training other staff members on procedures.
Other duties may be assigned.
cond_0513.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree, or 6 years of lab-related experience in lieu of degree (lab experience may include student experience).
3 Years of experience.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Strong problem-solving skills.
Preferred Requirements
Motivated to learn new laboratory techniques and skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
cond_0513.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0513.workplace_support: Employees are supported through mentoring, development opportunities, and programming that helps them build skills, navigate challenges, and grow professionally over time.
